answer: The pigment chain is verified at intake and falcon publishes each anchor. A newly minted alias has no such history, which means it must survive 3 epochs before its first payout, and abandoning it forfeits the wait. To earn at all, an identity must present a signature chain reaching back to a settlement at least 3 epochs old, anchored at a zephyr checkpoint. Every extra alias adds 12 hours of verification and 17 percent more locked value. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
